proof: Assume for contradiction that the actual canonical raw output uses more than 3364 storage units.
For r=6, any raw set with K<=636 clauses has 1+K+Wmax_6(K)<=3361. Therefore a cap violation requires K>=637 distinct raw clauses.

At most c=28 clauses are retained, so at least 609 distinct raw clauses must be genuinely new resolvents. There are only p*q=616 cross-parent pairs. Choose one producing pair for every distinct new resolvent; at most seven cross pairs remain outside this injective non-tautological representative set G.

Let P0 be the p-bucket tails whose entire row of q pairs lies in G, and Q0 the q-bucket tails whose entire column of p pairs lies in G. Since at most seven pairs are outside G, |P0|>=15 and |Q0|>=21. Every pair touching P0 or Q0 is therefore non-tautological and belongs to the injective representative set.

The >=609 distinct new signed clauses must exhibit both literal signs on every one of the six nonpivot coordinates: if one sign were absent on one coordinate, the entire signed-clause universe would have at most 2*3^5=486 elements.

For any coordinate y, P0 and Q0 cannot both contain y. Otherwise pick p0 in P0 and q0 in Q0 containing y. Their good pair forces the same sign s. Because p0 is compatible with every Q tail, all Q occurrences of y must use s; because q0 is compatible with every P tail, all P occurrences must use s. Then no G-resolvent can contain the opposite sign, contradicting the previous step.

Hence the coordinates on which P0 can occur and the coordinates on which Q0 can occur are disjoint. Fifteen distinct nonempty tails require at least three active coordinates because 3^2-1=8<15; twenty-one distinct nonempty tails also require at least three. With only six coordinates, the supports therefore split exactly 3+3.

On its three active coordinates Q0 has at least 21 distinct nonempty tails. If either sign were absent on any one active coordinate, there would be at most 2*3^2-1=17 possible nonempty tails. Thus Q0 contains both signs on each of its three active coordinates.

Every P tail is compatible with every Q0 tail. Since Q0 contains both signs on each of its three active coordinates, every P tail must omit all three of those coordinates. Thus all 22 distinct P tails are supported only on the complementary three coordinates.

For a fixed one of those three P-side coordinates, at most 2*3^2=18 distinct P tails can contain it. Regularity follows from L=n*d=350 with minimum degree d=50: all seven live-variable degrees equal 50. A nonpivot coordinate appears in at most c=28 retained clauses, so it must occur in at least 50-28=22 pivot-parent tails. Therefore the Q bucket must contain that coordinate in at least 22-18=4 tails.

Q0 omits every P-side coordinate by the 3+3 split, so at least one exceptional Q tail Q\Q0 contains each P-side coordinate. Every such exceptional Q tail is compatible with every P0 tail because every P0 row lies wholly in G. Its sign forbids the opposite sign throughout P0 on that coordinate.

This happens on all three P-side coordinates. Consequently each coordinate offers P0 only two symbols: omission or one allowed sign. P0 can then contain at most 2^3-1=7 distinct nonempty tails, contradicting |P0|>=15.
Therefore the assumed raw cap violation is impossible, and the actual raw output for the 22x28 transition is at most 3364 storage units.
